title: Massless and Point-Charge Limits of the Pauli–Fierz $g$-Factor
exact_target: Determine whether the Pauli--Fierz g-factor survives removal of both photon-mass and charge-size cutoffs, and compute its dependence on coupling.

status_qualification: The perturbative first correction is not a proof that the full cutoff limits exist. The two cutoff removals, possible order of limits, all-alpha dependence, and the second-order coefficient are separate questions. The g-factor definition is the source's equation (14), including effective-mass normalization.
